heading.en: The wobbling sound of two tuning forks

hook.en: Strike two tuning forks that are almost, but not quite, the same. The sound swells and fades, wah-wah-wah. Musicians use this to tune their instruments.
hook.kn: ಬಹುತೇಕ ಒಂದೇ ಆದರೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಭಿನ್ನವಾದ ಎರಡು ಶ್ರುತಿಕವೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಡಿಯಿರಿ. ಧ್ವನಿ ಏರಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಗೀತಗಾರರು ವಾದ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಶ್ರುತಿಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಇದನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

objectives.en: Find an unknown frequency by loading or filing a fork

narration.en: Strike two tuning forks that are almost, but not quite, the same. The sound swells and fades, wah-wah-wah. Musicians use this to tune their instruments.
narration.kn: ಬಹುತೇಕ ಒಂದೇ ಆದರೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಭಿನ್ನವಾದ ಎರಡು ಶ್ರುತಿಕವೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಡಿಯಿರಿ. ಧ್ವನಿ ಏರಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಗೀತಗಾರರು ವಾದ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಶ್ರುತಿಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಇದನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

body.en: When two sound waves of slightly different frequencies ν₁ and ν₂ overlap, they drift in and out of step. The resultant has a rapid oscillation at the average frequency, with an amplitude that rises and falls. Each rise is heard as a beat, and the number of beats per second is ν_beat = |ν₁ − ν₂|. The ear can count beats only up to about 10 per second.
body.kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಭಿನ್ನ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳ ಎರಡು ಧ್ವನಿ ತರಂಗಗಳು ಸೇರಿದಾಗ ಫಲಿತ ಕಂಪನ ವಿಸ್ತಾರ ಏರಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೆಕೆಂಡಿಗೆ ಸ್ಪಂದನಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = |ν₁ − ν₂|.

points.en: Heard clearly only when the difference is small

The resultant has a rapid oscillation at the average frequency, with an amplitude that rises and falls. Each rise is heard as a beat, and the number of beats per second is ν_beat = |ν₁ − ν₂|. The ear can count beats only up to about 10 per second.
narration.kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಭಿನ್ನ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳ ಎರಡು ಧ್ವನಿ ತರಂಗಗಳು ಸೇರಿದಾಗ ಫಲಿತ ಕಂಪನ ವಿಸ್ತಾರ ಏರಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೆಕೆಂಡಿಗೆ ಸ್ಪಂದನಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = |ν₁ − ν₂|.

say.en: Two notes of slightly different frequency are played together. Sometimes they are in step and add up; sometimes they cancel.
Their sum swells and fades. Each swell is one beat. The loudness rises and falls at the difference of the frequencies.
Beat frequency equals the difference of the two frequencies. 256 and 260 hertz give 4 beats per second.
Finding an unknown fork: it gives 4 beats with a 256 hertz fork, so it is 252 or 260 hertz. Loading it with wax lowers its frequency.
After waxing the beats rise to 6 per second. Lowering it moved it further from 256, so it was below: 252 hertz.

narration.en: Two notes of slightly different frequency are played together. Sometimes they are in step and add up; sometimes they cancel. Their sum swells and fades. Each swell is one beat. The loudness rises and falls at the difference of the frequencies. Beat frequency equals the difference of the two frequencies. 256 and 260 hertz give 4 beats per second. Finding an unknown fork: it gives 4 beats with a 256 hertz fork, so it is 252 or 260 hertz. Loading it with wax lowers its frequency. After waxing the beats rise to 6 per second. Lowering it moved it further from 256, so it was below: 252 hertz.

body.en: Beats tell us how close two frequencies are, so instruments are tuned until the beats disappear. Loading a tuning fork prong with wax lowers its frequency; filing the prong raises it. Watching whether the beats increase or decrease after loading or filing tells us whether the unknown frequency is above or below the known one.
body.kn: ಸ್ಪಂದನಗಳು ಮಾಯವಾಗುವವರೆಗೆ ವಾದ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಶ್ರುತಿಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಶ್ರುತಿಕವೆಗೆ ಮೇಣ ಹಚ್ಚಿದರೆ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ; ಉಜ್ಜಿದರೆ (ಫೈಲ್) ಹೆಚ್ಚು.

caption.en: The sum of two waves of frequencies f₁ and f₂ (slowed down so you can see them). The red envelope rises and falls |f₁ − f₂| times a second.

tryThis.en: Bring f₂ closer to f₁. Do the beats get slower or faster?
Set f₁ = f₂. What happens to the beats? This is how musicians tune.
With f₁ = 10 Hz you see 3 beats/s. What are the two possible values of f₂?

problem.en: Two forks of 256 Hz and 260 Hz are sounded together. How many beats are heard per second?

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Two forks of 256 Hz and 260 Hz are sounded together. How many beats are heard per second?

problem.en: An unknown fork gives 5 beats per second with a 256 Hz fork. When the unknown fork is loaded with a little wax, the beats increase. Find its frequency.

steps.en: Loading lowers the unknown frequency. If it were 261 Hz, beats would decrease; if 251 Hz, they would increase.
Beats increased, so the frequency is 251 Hz.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. An unknown fork gives 5 beats per second with a 256 Hz fork. When the unknown fork is loaded with a little wax, the beats increase. Find its frequency.

body.en: Wax on a prong makes it heavier: lower frequency. Filing removes metal: higher frequency. If loading increases the beats, the unknown fork was the lower one.
